name: JazzHR
summary: JazzHR sells three yearly plans at $1,000, $3,480 and $5,508 with no monthly option shown. The Hero plan starts at 3 jobs a month, and some add-ons are billed by usage at rates the pricing page does not give. Standard pricing may not apply to staffing agencies or companies over 250 employees.

facts.text: JazzHR's features page shows jobs auto-posted to Indeed, LinkedIn, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, Monster and Facebook.
JazzHR describes workflows as customizable recruiting stages with built-in automation.
Its interview scheduler sends automatic reminders, lets candidates self-schedule, and collects comments and rankings inside applicant profiles.

plans.name: Hero
plans.notes: Starting at 3 jobs a month. Job posting availability is subject to eligibility at JazzHR's discretion.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Up to 200 active jobs. Advanced visual reporting and offers with eSignatures are add-ons.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Offers with eSignatures and advanced visual reporting are listed as add-ons in the comparison table.

hiddenCosts: No monthly price is shown. The page says paying yearly saves up to 24%.
Some add-on features are billed by how much you use them, and the page does not say which features or at what rates.
Premium listings and syndication to extra boards cost more, with no prices given.
Standard pricing may not apply to staffing agencies, HR service providers, franchises, multi-location businesses or organizations with over 250 employees.
